title: Adaptive-runtime experiment-control foundation verification
scope: Verify the architecture, schemas, canonical instances, compatibility decision, fixtures, reference resolution, canonical serialization, and hashing for the experiment-control checkpoint without implementing or executing a plan compiler, runtime change, behavior materializer, analytics, or performance work.
verification_method: Canonical SpecTrace validation, PowerShell JSON Schema and semantic validation, deterministic repeated canonicalization and SHA-256 checks, focused requirement-home tests, a narrow test-project build, and diff validation.
preconditions: The primary dirty ACK-profile slice remains preserved in its original worktree.
The checkpoint runs from isolated source commit 2c234bc92ed67fb7aa49f1e5ea6271b11c918ac8.
Every authorization field remains false and current runtime one-axis capability remains unchanged.
Performance measurement, campaigns, transforms, ML, CI, push, active_internal, and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate the specification, architecture, work item, and verification documents against the canonical SpecTrace model and reciprocal links.
Parse and validate all eight new JSON Schemas.
Validate all five canonical instance documents and all valid fixtures.
Require every invalid fixture to fail with its stable expected error code.

Prove unknown fields, illegal and unsupported values, bad authorization, blocked or preparation-only execution, duplicates, unknown and stale references, missing predicate references, fixed/varied overlap, and malformed hashes fail.
Canonicalize the same documents repeatedly and require byte-identical UTF-8 output.
Hash the same canonical bytes repeatedly and require identical lowercase SHA-256.
Run the focused REQ-QUIC-CRT-0198 through REQ-QUIC-CRT-0201 requirement-home tests.
Build only the affected test project and run git diff --check.
Confirm the old v1 catalog schema, generator, fixtures, and retained evidence remain unchanged.
Confirm no performance, campaign, transform, ML, CI, push, active_internal, or production action occurred.
expected_result: The experiment-control architecture is canonical; all eight schemas and five initial instance documents validate; every valid fixture passes and every invalid fixture fails deterministically; repeated canonical bytes and hashes match; the historical v1 catalog remains valid and explicitly compatibility-only; trace links are complete; and no runtime or active behavior changes.
status_summary: The focused validator passes all eight schemas, five canonical documents, twelve valid fixtures, and fifteen deterministically invalid fixtures with zero code mismatches. Repeated validator output, canonical serialization, and SHA-256 recomputation are byte-identical. The affected Release test project builds with zero warnings and errors, and the four focused requirement-home tests pass. The four new SpecTrace artifacts validate directly against the repository model with reciprocal links; repository-wide core validation remains blocked by 2,693 baseline-wide schema and unresolved-reference errors beginning in unchanged API and RFC artifacts. The historical policy-catalog v1 schema and producer remain unchanged. No performance, campaign, transform, ML, CI, push, active_internal, or production action occurred.
